description: This file declares internal API functions for the Sys Repository Record Object, including getters and setters for record attributes and data access functions.

methods.name: SysRroGetBirthTime
methods.description: Retrieves the birth time of the record.

methods.name: SysRroSetBirthTime
methods.description: Sets the birth time of the record.

methods.name: SysRroGetRenderAttr
methods.description: Gets the render attributes of the record.

methods.name: SysRroSetRenderAttr
methods.description: Sets the render attributes of the record.

methods.name: SysRroGetParentFolder
methods.description: Retrieves the parent folder of the record.

methods.name: SysRroSetParentFolder
methods.description: Sets the parent folder of the record.

methods.name: SysRroGetUserContext
methods.description: Gets the user context associated with the record.

methods.name: SysRroSetUserContext
methods.description: Sets the user context associated with the record.

methods.name: SysRroGetUserReserved
methods.description: Retrieves the user-reserved field.

methods.name: SysRroSetUserReserved
methods.description: Sets the user-reserved field.

methods.name: SysRroGetRecordName
methods.description: Gets the record name.

methods.name: SysRroSetRecordName
methods.description: Sets the record name.

methods.name: SysRroGetRecordType
methods.description: Retrieves the record type.

methods.name: SysRroSetRecordType
methods.description: Sets the record type.

methods.name: SysRroGetPermission
methods.description: Gets the permission settings of the record.

methods.name: SysRroSetPermission
methods.description: Sets the permission settings of the record.

methods.name: SysRroGetContentType
methods.description: Retrieves the content type of the record.

methods.name: SysRroSetContentType
methods.description: Sets the content type of the record.

methods.name: SysRroGrantAccess
methods.description: Checks if access is granted based on access mode.

methods.name: SysRroGetRecordSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of the record.

methods.name: SysRroGetRecordData
methods.description: Gets the data associated with the record.

methods.name: SysRroSetRecordData
methods.description: Sets the data associated with the record.
